verdict.rationale: Greptile review comments include suggested code. A one-click 'Fix with your Agent' button (plus 'Fix All') hands the issue and suggested fix to an external coding agent such as Claude Code, Cursor, Codex or Devin to apply. That is one-click remediation, but it routes through a separate agent rather than a natively committable diff applied in the PR. Missing for 10: evidence of native committable suggestion blocks (e.g. GitHub suggested changes) applied directly in the PR without an external agent, and independent hands-on corroboration.
